Chapter 727 - 727 Li Ke'S Chance; Universe Competition!

Chapter 727 - 727 Li Ke's Chance; Universe Competition!

727 Li Ke’s Chance; Universe Competition!

Challenge… To Lin Fan, it was just a small matter that happened after a meal.

It would be over with a smile.

After Lin Fan returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa, his consciousness entered the River of Time. He was prepared to test and master the power of laws that he had grasped over the years.

In the white river of time.

Lin Fan took a step forward. Life, death, yin, yang… On the main paths of the various elements, he walked for more than 30,000 meters.

Then, he changed to the paths of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth that symbolized the five elements…

On these roads, he met many people.

However, Lin Fan turned a blind eye to all of them. He kept walking forward, leaving behind a carefree and admiring back view.

However, when he walked onto the fire path, he suddenly stopped in his tracks.

That was because he accidentally saw someone.

A familiar person.

“Li Ke?” Lin Fan said.

At this moment, Li Ke seemed very confused.

When he heard Lin Fan’s voice, he turned around and said in surprise, “Master!”

Lin Fan said, “Why are you here?”

He remembered that Li Ke had a very good fire talent, and Qin Menghu had a very good sword talent.

However, they were still very weak.

Therefore, Lin Fan didn’t teach them Fire and Sword skills.

It was just to let Little Rock quickly increase their cultivation.

Also, didn’t Li Ke go out to avenge his parents a few years ago?

Why was he in the River of Time now?

He could do it with his own ability?

Was his talent that powerful?

“Master, I think…” Li Ke said. “I transmigrated!”

Transmigration?

Lin Fan’s face revealed a look of surprise.

Then, Li Ke roughly told him about the revenge ten years ago.

Lin Fan nodded his head and said, “Which universe are you in now?”

“Mero Cosmos, Flame Domain Burning Star,” Li Ke said. “This place is under the jurisdiction of the Fire God Palace. However, the Fire God Palace’s palace master seemed to have died not too long ago, causing the Fire God Palace to suffer a huge blow.

“In order to recover their vitality, the Fire God Palace has been searching for fire attribute geniuses to nurture over the years. They allowed me to become a substitute for the Fire God Palace’s Holy Son and even gave me a lot of resources to nurture. Then, they used a special method to let me enter the River of Time.

“But don’t worry, Master. I’m still yours, and that will never change!”

When Lin Fan heard this, his face turned weird.

He killed the palace master of the Fire God Palace.

The Fire God Palace was using huge resources to nurture his disciple?

Lin Fan nodded his head. “Alright. Cultivate well. After that, work hard to get a higher status in Fire God Palace.”

“Yes, Master!” Li Ke said.

Then, Lin Fan continued to walk along the Fire Dao.

After Lin Fan’s soul returned, he asked quietly, “System, is what Li Ke said true?”

[Requires 100,000 spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

“Inquire!”

[It’s true.]

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Li Ke’s favorability towards you has increased to 7 stars.]

When Lin Fan heard this, he broke out into a smile.

He turned his eyes slightly and used soul communication with Li Ke.

“Li Ke!”

…

Mero Cosmos, Flame Domain Burning Star.

Li Ke thought back to how Lin Fan was walking in the river of time and couldn’t help but praise,””As expected of Master! He’s too powerful!”

Suddenly, he heard Lin Fan’s voice and was stunned.

Then, he revealed a respectful expression that was difficult to hide.

“Hello, Master.”

Lin Fan said,” I’ll teach you a skill now. I hope you cultivate it well. It’s called True Flame Skill.””

“Yes, sir!” Li Ke said.

When the soul connection ended, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Li Ke’s favorability towards you has increased to 8 stars.]

When Lin Fan heard that, his lips curled up,” It wasn’t in vain for me to teach you.””

….

Four Seasons Universe.

Summer Region, Maple Leaf Planet.

People were singing and dancing, shopping and strolling. Everyone was very relaxed and at ease.

At this moment, a huge starship suddenly appeared in the sky.

Everyone raised their heads in confusion and discussed in low voices.

“What is this?”

“Why did he suddenly appear in the air?”

“Is it some big shot who came to our planet?”

“Should we line up to welcome him?”

….

What responded to them were countless terrifying energy cannons.

“Boom!”

“Boom!”

The earth shook violently, and dust flew everywhere.

“Enemy attack!”

“Run!”

“Star Lord, save me!”

….

Cries and screams resounded throughout the entire planet.

Maple Leaf Star Master heard this and soared into the sky, about to launch an attack on the starship.

However…

“Whoosh!”

A dazzling pillar of light instantly drowned his figure and turned him into ashes.

The Maple Leaf Planet had fallen.

….

In fact, it was not just Maple Leaf Planet.

The Pine Star, Sandalwood Star, Green Star, and other planets of the Summer Territory were all under fierce attack at almost the same time.

The entire Summer Territory was falling at a rate visible to the naked eye.

The ruler of the Summer Territory was furious when he heard the news.

He personally led the army to counterattack.

However, this was clearly a premeditated attack.

How could they let the ruler of the Summer Territory get what he wanted?

As soon as the ruler of the Summer Territory set off, he was attacked fiercely.

” How dare you!” he shouted.” Ocean Universe, how dare you! Do you want to start a universe war?””

The tall man with a shark head grinned and said,”The war has already begun, idiot!”

As soon as he finished speaking, a terrifying energy burst out from his body and vaguely formed a giant white shark that was tens of thousands of square kilometers in the sky.

The white shark opened its ferocious mouth and swept out a tyrannical aura. It tore through space and fiercely bit into the Summer Territory.

The Summer Territory’s ruler’s expression changed slightly as he hurriedly blocked the attack.

“Boom!”

A terrifying energy wave spread rapidly like a wave.

At this moment, a man with a seal head appeared not far away. He said coldly,”Hasn’t it been resolved yet? Too slow.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he seemed to have transformed into a golden light and instantly arrived in front of the ruler of the Summer Territory.

“Boom!”

With a wave of his hand, he sent the ruler of the Summer Territory flying and spat out a large mouthful of blood.

The man with the seal head didn’t stop and continued flying forward.

The ruler of the Summer Territory knew that he was unable to resist.

Therefore, he quickly activated the talisman hidden in his body.

“Whoosh!”

Space swirled, and the ruler of the Summer Territory instantly disappeared without a trace.

“A teleportation talisman? Forget it, so be it. Our mission was to conquer the Summer Territory anyway, and we’ve succeeded.”

P.S. Welcome to my final book, Super Red Envelope Immortals.
